checks.title: Manifest location
checks.problem: The manifest is not at applications/<app_id>/manifest.yml, or the application ID is not valid.
checks.fix: Put the manifest at applications/<app_id>/manifest.yml. Application ID: up to 63 characters, lower-case Latin letters, digits, `_`, `-` and `.`; at least two dots, none at the start or end or in a row. e.g. `com.example.weather`, or `io.github.<your-github-user>.<app>` if you don't have a website.

checks.title: Application ID style
checks.problem: The application ID does not start with a domain-like part.
checks.fix: Recommended: a reverse-domain ID (Java package style), e.g. `com.example.weather`, or `io.github.<your-github-user>.<app>` if you don't have a website.

checks.title: Changed files
checks.problem: PR must change exactly one application manifest.
checks.fix: Keep only `applications/<id>/manifest.yml` in this PR; other changes are made by maintainers.

checks.title: Application ID format
checks.problem: The application ID in the folder name is not valid.
checks.fix: Application ID: up to 63 characters, lower-case Latin letters, digits, `_`, `-` and `.`; at least two dots, none at the start or end or in a row. e.g. `com.example.weather`, or `io.github.<your-github-user>.<app>` if you don't have a website.

checks.title: Who removes the app
checks.problem: Only the app's author or catalog maintainers can remove an app, and this pull request's author is neither.
checks.fix: Ask the maintainers to remove it: open an issue in this repository and name the app.

checks.title: App in the catalog
checks.problem: The app is not in the catalog: it was never published or is already removed.
checks.fix: Nothing else to do: merging only cleans the repository.

checks.title: Manifest syntax
checks.problem: The manifest is not readable YAML.
checks.fix: Fix the YAML syntax of manifest.yml at the line named in the details.

checks.title: Manifest fields
checks.problem: A manifest field is missing or has a wrong value.
checks.fix: In manifest.yml, add the missing field or correct the value of the field named in the details.

checks.title: Manifest paths
checks.problem: A path or file reference in the manifest is not allowed.
checks.fix: Use relative paths inside the application directory; `@file` is allowed only in description.

checks.title: Changelog
checks.problem: The changelog is a file reference, or shorter than 10 or longer than 4000 characters.
checks.fix: Write the changelog in `manifest.yml` as inline text of 10 to 4000 characters.

checks.title: Official namespace
checks.problem: The ID starts with `app.busy.`, which official BUSY apps use, but the repository is not from the busy-app organization.
checks.fix: Check this is not an impersonation of an official app; otherwise use an ID of your own (for example `io.github.<your-user>.<app>`).

checks.title: Category
checks.problem: The category is not in the public category list.
checks.fix: Set `category` in manifest.yml to one of the allowed categories named in the details.

checks.title: Category name
checks.problem: The category is an alias of another category.
checks.fix: Use the main category name in `category`.

checks.title: Category list
checks.problem: The public category list could not be loaded.
checks.fix: Nothing to do: the local copy of the categories was used.

checks.title: Source repository
checks.problem: The source is not a GitHub HTTPS repository or the commit is not a full SHA.
checks.fix: Set `sourcecode.location.origin` to https://github.com/<owner>/<repo> and `commit_sha` to the full 40-character SHA.

checks.title: Source commit
checks.problem: No commit found.
checks.fix: Check that the corresponding commit is available in your repository and that `commit_sha` in the manifest is the full 40-character SHA.

checks.title: Source directory
checks.problem: The source subdirectory is missing or outside the repository.
checks.fix: Set `sourcecode.location.subdir` to a directory that exists at that commit.

checks.title: Application ID
checks.problem: Application ID doesn't match.
checks.fix: Rename the folder to match the `id` in your app's appmeta/manifest.json, or change that `id` and push a new commit. Application ID: up to 63 characters, lower-case Latin letters, digits, `_`, `-` and `.`; at least two dots, none at the start or end or in a row. e.g. `com.example.weather`, or `io.github.<your-github-user>.<app>` if you don't have a website.

checks.title: Open source license
checks.problem: The repository has no license file at the submitted commit.
checks.fix: Add a LICENSE file with an open source license (for example MIT or GPL) to your repository, and submit a commit that contains it.

checks.title: License text
checks.problem: The license text was not recognised, the moderator will check it.
checks.fix: Use the unmodified text of a standard open source license, for example from choosealicense.com.

checks.title: Referenced files
checks.problem: A file referenced from the manifest is missing or outside the application directory.
checks.fix: Commit the file at the path used in the manifest, inside the application directory.

checks.title: Description and changelog
checks.problem: A description or changelog is too short or too long.
checks.fix: Keep `description` between 50 and 4000 characters (after `@file` is read) and `changelog` between 10 and 4000.

checks.title: Markdown
checks.problem: The description or changelog uses unsupported Markdown.
checks.fix: In `description` and `changelog` use only level 1–2 headings, bold, italic, lists and links; remove the element named in the details.

checks.title: Screenshot count
checks.problem: There must be 1–10 screenshots.
checks.fix: List 1–10 PNG files under `screenshots`.

checks.title: Back screenshot count
checks.problem: There can be at most 10 back screenshots.
checks.fix: List 0–10 PNG files under `back_screenshots`, or remove the field.

checks.title: Screenshot files
checks.problem: A screenshot is not a valid 72×16 PNG.
checks.fix: Replace the listed file with a valid PNG of exactly 72×16 pixels.

checks.title: Source size
checks.problem: The committed source is larger than 100 MiB.
checks.fix: Remove large files from the repository at that commit.

checks.title: Back screenshot files
checks.problem: A back screenshot is not a valid 160×80 PNG.
checks.fix: Replace the listed file with a valid 8-bit PNG of exactly 160×80 pixels.

checks.title: Lock file
checks.problem: The lock file or package manager version is not pinned.
checks.fix: Commit exactly one of package-lock.json or pnpm-lock.yaml with a pinned @busy-app/cli (and `packageManager` for pnpm).

checks.title: Build
checks.problem: The build failed.
checks.fix: Check that the `id` in appmeta/manifest.json is the folder name and that `busy-cli build` succeeds locally with the pinned toolchain.

checks.title: Entry script
checks.problem: scripts/main.js is missing, unreadable or too large.
checks.fix: Make the build output scripts/main.js of at most 256000 bytes.

checks.title: Script imports
checks.problem: A script has a syntax error or imports a file that is not in the package.
checks.fix: Fix the syntax and use only relative imports of files inside scripts/.

checks.title: Screenshot files after the build
checks.problem: A screenshot is no longer a valid 72×16 PNG after the build, or could not be re-saved.
checks.fix: Make sure the build doesn't change your screenshots and that they are 8-bit PNGs of exactly 72×16 pixels.

checks.title: Back screenshot files after the build
checks.problem: A back screenshot is no longer a valid 160×80 PNG after the build, or could not be re-saved.
checks.fix: Make sure the build doesn't change your back screenshots and that they are 8-bit PNGs of exactly 160×80 pixels.

checks.title: Application icons
checks.problem: The application icon is not a valid 8×8 PNG (or the back icon is not a valid 11×11 PNG).
checks.fix: Replace `appmeta/icon_front_8x8.png` in your app with a valid 8-bit PNG of exactly 8×8 pixels (`appmeta/icon_back_11x11.png`, if present, must be 11×11).

checks.title: Application icon
checks.problem: The application has no front icon, so the catalog shows a default one.
checks.fix: Add `appmeta/icon_front_8x8.png` to your app: a PNG of exactly 8×8 pixels.

checks.title: Package built
checks.problem: The build did not produce a readable package.
checks.fix: Re-run the checks. If it fails again, ask the maintainers.

checks.title: Application ID
checks.problem: The application ID is not valid.
checks.fix: Application ID: up to 63 characters, lower-case Latin letters, digits, `_`, `-` and `.`; at least two dots, none at the start or end or in a row. e.g. `com.example.weather`, or `io.github.<your-github-user>.<app>` if you don't have a website.

checks.title: Package size
checks.problem: The package is too large.
checks.fix: Reduce the compressed package to at most 100 MiB.

checks.title: Unpacked size
checks.problem: The unpacked package is too large.
checks.fix: Reduce the unpacked archive to at most 128 MiB.

checks.title: Archive entries
checks.problem: The package has too many files.
checks.fix: Reduce the archive to at most 10000 entries.

checks.title: Archive format
checks.problem: The package is not a readable gzip tar archive.
checks.fix: Provide a readable gzip tar archive.

checks.title: Tar format
checks.problem: The archive is not a plain USTAR archive.
checks.fix: Create a USTAR archive without GNU or PAX headers.

checks.title: Package paths
checks.problem: A file is outside the application ID directory.
checks.fix: Place all package files under the application ID directory.

checks.title: Duplicate paths
checks.problem: The archive has duplicate paths.
checks.fix: Remove duplicate archive paths.

checks.title: Entry types
checks.problem: The archive has entries other than files and directories.
checks.fix: Use regular files and directories only.

checks.title: JavaScript size
checks.problem: A JavaScript file is too large.
checks.fix: Reduce each JavaScript file to at most 256000 bytes.

checks.title: Entry script in package
checks.problem: scripts/main.js is not in the package.
checks.fix: Include scripts/main.js in the package.

checks.title: App manifest in package
checks.problem: appmeta/manifest.json is not in the package.
checks.fix: Include appmeta/manifest.json in the package.

checks.title: App manifest size
checks.problem: appmeta/manifest.json is too large.
checks.fix: Reduce manifest.json to at most 512 bytes.

checks.title: App manifest JSON
checks.problem: appmeta/manifest.json is not a JSON object.
checks.fix: Provide a valid JSON manifest object.

checks.title: App manifest fields
checks.problem: A required field is missing in appmeta/manifest.json.
checks.fix: Add the missing field to manifest.json.

checks.title: App manifest format
checks.problem: format_version is not 1.
checks.fix: Set format_version to the integer 1.

checks.title: App manifest ID
checks.problem: The ID in appmeta/manifest.json differs from the catalog application ID.
checks.fix: Rename the folder to match the `id` in your app's appmeta/manifest.json, or change that `id` and push a new commit. Application ID: up to 63 characters, lower-case Latin letters, digits, `_`, `-` and `.`; at least two dots, none at the start or end or in a row. e.g. `com.example.weather`, or `io.github.<your-github-user>.<app>` if you don't have a website.

checks.title: App name
checks.problem: The application name is empty, longer than 32 characters, or has characters or spaces the design does not allow.
checks.fix: Set `name` in appmeta/manifest.json to 1–32 characters: Latin letters, digits, single spaces between words and ! ? & ' ( ) + , - . / : # $ % @ _

checks.title: App versions
checks.problem: version or api_version is not numeric semantic versioning.
checks.fix: Use numeric versions like 1.2.3 for version and api_version.

checks.title: Heap size
checks.problem: heap_size_kib is out of range.
checks.fix: Set heap_size_kib between 1 and 512.

checks.title: Debug mode
checks.problem: Debug mode is enabled.
checks.fix: Disable debug mode in the published app.

checks.title: Version is new
checks.problem: The version is not higher than the published one.
checks.fix: Increase the application version above the published version.

checks.title: Same repository
checks.problem: The update comes from another repository than the published app.
checks.fix: Submit the update from the repository the app was published from.

checks.title: Firmware API

checks.fix: Set api_version no higher than the latest released API.
